# Why Every Developer Should Try a CTF

Capture the Flag competitions are not just for security researchers. They sharpen skills every developer uses daily.

## You'll learn to read code differently

CTF challenges force you to understand code at the bit level — exactly how parsers, serializers, and crypto routines work under the hood.

## You'll appreciate input validation

After crafting your first SQL injection payload, you'll never forget to parameterise a query again.

## Where to start

- [picoCTF](https://picoctf.org) — beginner friendly
- [HackTheBox](https://hackthebox.com) — intermediate machines
- [CTFtime](https://ctftime.org) — upcoming event calendar

Give it a try. The worst outcome is learning something new.
title: Why every developer should try a CTF
